rules: Queue AGENTS.md and docs/interfaces.md require queue-to-CY dependency direction, explicit outer integration owners, exact source/installed metadata and checked bounded compatibility.

modules.responsibility: Declare the verified CY compatibility bound and package fix version
modules.interface: Queue 0.1.5 admits CY >=0.38,<0.45 after isolated CY 0.44.0 verification; future minor 0.45 remains excluded
allowed_dependencies: Documented CY outer integration interfaces and existing queue dependencies
forbidden_dependencies: Queue policy importing CY, SDKs or documentation serving
modules.effects: External installer owns dependency resolution; proposed checks own private snapshots and environment; no operational installation changes

contracts.rules: Source and installed versions agree and satisfy bounded requirement; imports and console entrypoint work outside source directories
Exact CY caller ownership and injected forbidden direct/type-only/dynamic/process edges remain enforced
Queue layers point inward and policy does not import CY or SDK effects transitively

checks.command: Private environment python -m pytest -q from the captured queue source
checks.expectation: Entire ordinary suite passes, including current-source metadata and exact CY caller ownership with injected forbidden edges

checks.command: Private environment lint-imports from the captured queue source
checks.expectation: Both inward-layer and policy-isolation contracts pass

checks.command: Private environment ruff check ., ruff format --check ., and mypy . from the captured queue source
checks.expectation: Configured lint, formatting and strict typing pass without exemptions

checks.command: uv pip install --python PRIVATE_PYTHON -r frozen-requirements.txt -e CY_SOURCE -e QUEUE_SOURCE; uv pip check --python PRIVATE_PYTHON; source/installed metadata and origin probe
checks.expectation: Normal resolution accepts CY 0.44.0 and queue 0.1.5 with exact matching metadata and approved external source pins

checks.command: Private environment python executes the deny-documentation train/pipeline composition probe and cy-queue --help
checks.expectation: Queue command composition and installed help work with documentation import failures
Task Markdown and local links pass

documentation: Existing development/interfaces/migration guidance remains accurate. Add this scoped plan, architecture record and dated verification; preserve previous compatibility history.

review.reconciliation: Reviewed complete task-owned diff: only pyproject package version and tested CY bound plus scoped plan/architecture/verification documents. No runtime/test files, approved dependencies or operational environment changed. Fresh final candidate pair checks cover the final Artifactory implementation; release-source metadata refresh remains a separate delivery check.
